mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 31 degrees with clear skies observed at Verona City Hall under a full moon.
City offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. Please note that refuse and recycling pickup normally scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27.

You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow is packed with activities, including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In a report from November 2, officers were called to a residence on West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, resulting in one arrest.
The delicious Butter Pecan is our flavor of the day, and the team will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
